indian_angle: This initiative by BAI aims to uplift the quality of coaching across India, which is vital for nurturing talent from grassroots to elite levels.

title: India U17 & U15 Junior Team Camp Held for Asia Championships

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This change in scoring system for junior domestic events will impact how young Indian players train and compete, potentially influencing their development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.

title: BAI Notifies on Service Height Measuring Device Transfer
